                    Equipment / Accessories
                      

                    Cloaks | Rogue Trader Wiki

                    Updated: 01 Jul 2025 02:21

                    Cloaks are one of the accessories that can be equipped by players. Each accessory contain its unique defensive Stats, effects, bonuses, skill checks, and more when they are equipped. Accessories are usually obtained as rewards from completing Quests, purchased from Merchants, looted from various locations, crafted, or are dropped by Enemies and Bosses. This page will indicate a list of all the Cloaks in Warhammer 40k: Rogue Trader which will include its description and values. You can find detailed information on its location and properties on each individual page linked below.
